exposure: severity of pulmonary hypertension (mild vs. moderate-to-severe PH)
cohort: The study included 70 pregnant women with pulmonary hypertension admitted to the First Affiliated Hospital of Zhengzhou University between January 2012 and December 2022.
finding: Pregnancy complicated with pulmonary hypertension (PH) poses a significant risk to both maternal and neonatal health, with poorer outcomes associated with moderate-to-severe PH.
mod_finding: The majority of patients (87.50% vs. 86.67%) underwent cesarean section.
birth_weight: Significantly lower in the moderate-to-severe PH group, with a greater proportion of low birth weights.
gest_age: Median gestational age at delivery was 36.57 weeks for the mild PH group and 33.93 weeks for the moderate-to-severe PH group.
